title: stock_dropshipping — SO→PO→direct delivery cross-module chain L3

key_findings.picking_type_code: dropship (new selection value added by this module)
key_findings.chain_trigger: SO confirm → sale_stock SaleOrderLine._action_launch_stock_rule() → stock.rule.run() → purchase_stock StockRule._run_buy() → purchase.order.create()
key_findings.valuation: stock_account StockMove._is_dropshipped() → is_dropship=True → _action_done includes in moves_in → _set_value() → SVL created; _is_out() excludes dropship to prevent duplicate COGS
key_findings.return_flow: stock_account StockMove._is_dropshipped_returned() — customer→supplier direction → own valuation category
key_findings.no_internal_stock: supplier-location → customer-location only; no warehouse internal location involved in any move
key_findings.procurement_merge_blocked: stock_dropshipping StockRule._get_procurements_to_merge_groupby() adds sale_line_id to groupby key
key_findings.po_grouping_by_reference: purchase_stock StockRule._make_po_get_domain() adds reference_ids filter when code==dropship

claims.summary: Module depends on sale_purchase_stock
Dropship rule: action=buy, src=supplier, dest=customer
Dropship picking type: code=dropship, no warehouse
picking.type code selection extended with dropship
Dropship picking type src defaults to supplier location
Dropship picking type dest defaults to customer location
StockPicking.is_dropship computed from location usages
SO confirm → _action_launch_stock_rule → stock.rule.run()
_run_buy finds/creates PO for dropship rule
PO created with dropship picking_type_id and dest_address_id
_get_destination_location returns customer.property_stock_customer for dropship
_prepare_picking: src=vendor supplier, dest=customer location
_create_or_update_picking reuses picking with customer dest
Procurement merge blocked per SO line for delivered-qty traceability
Partner-id filter bypassed for dropship route
_is_dropshipped: src=supplier usage AND dest=customer usage
Valued types include dropshipped and dropshipped_returned
is_dropship moves included in _set_value at action_done
_is_out() excludes dropshipped moves — no double COGS
Dropship unit cost = weighted average of move values
_is_dropshipped_returned: customer→supplier direction, own valuation category
Return to internal stock: receipt qty not double-decremented
SO qty reads PO lines for dropship (no internal moves)
Service product dropship: dest_address and picking_type set on PO
Dropship PO domain always includes reference_ids filter
